<?php
function memoize(callable $fn) {
  $cache = [];
  return function (...$args) use ($fn, &$cache) {
    $key = serialize($args);
    return $cache[$key] ??= $fn(...$args);
  };
}

<?php
function quicksort($arr) {
  if (count($arr) <= 1) return $arr;
  $pivot = $arr[0];
  $rest = array_slice($arr, 1);
  $left = array_filter($rest, fn($x) => $x < $pivot);
  $right = array_filter($rest, fn($x) => $x >= $pivot);
  return [...quicksort($left), $pivot, ...quicksort($right)];
}

function withRetry(callable $fn, int $times = 3) {
  for ($i = 0; $i < $times; $i++) {
    try {
      return $fn();
    } catch (Exception $e) {
      if ($i === $times - 1) throw $e;
    }
  }
}
